title: The manifest

posts.caption:
5 day size exchange. 30 days on defects. Written on every card.

Every DAUR box carries a Manifest Card: why we exist on one side, your terms on the other, including 48 hours to report a wrong or damaged item. Men's leather shoes, sold in Pakistan with Cash on Delivery. At least 5% of our profit goes to verified cases in need.

First photo: mood photography of leather (Pexels). Kit shown is a design render.

Save this for when your first pair arrives.
